scope: Catalog Attributes: server-enforced required completeness + atomic bulk model-spec save + public passport archived-definition fix

businessFlow.subject: Admin edits a product model's specifications via a single bulk form; the server enforces required-attribute completeness atomically (reject incomplete, persist complete) and shows a completeness indicator

notes: Model specifications now save atomically through a single bulk form (PUT /api/v1/admin/product-models/:id/specifications). The domain assertRequiredSpecificationValues enforces that every required definition has a value before any row is written (all-or-nothing in one transaction), so a model can never be left half-complete. The admin page shows a 'N of M required attributes set' completeness banner. The public passport listing repository now filters archived spec definitions (d.status='ACTIVE') for consistency with the catalog read. Verified headed: clearing the required value and saving returned 422 'Specification values are invalid' with the DB value unchanged (atomic); setting 15.6 persisted; restored to 14. The single 422 console entry is the deliberate rejection, not a defect.
